A horizontal chord has its midpoint directly above or below the centre.
Substitute $y = 4$ into the circle equation:
$$(x - 5)^2 + (4 - 1)^2 = 25$$
$$(x - 5)^2 + 9 = 25 \implies (x - 5)^2 = 16$$

Solve for $x$:
$$x - 5 = 4 \implies x = 9 \implies B(9, 4)$$
$$x - 5 = -4 \implies x = 1 \implies A(1, 4)$$

hints: Observe that the centre of the circle is $(5, 1)$, which has the same $x$-coordinate $5$.
